            const html = document.querySelector('html');
            let theme;
            let scrollY = 0;

            if (document.cookie.includes('lequipe-no-placeholder=1') || document.cookie.includes('lequipe-no-placeholder-qlf=1')) {
                html.classList.add('no-placeholder');
            }

            if (document.cookie.includes('lequipe-session-token') || document.cookie.includes('lequipe-session-token-qlf')) {
                html.classList.add('connected-user');
            }
            const sessionInfos = localStorage.getItem('lequipe-session-infos') || localStorage.getItem('lequipe-session-infos-qlf');
            if (sessionInfos?.includes('%22hasSubscription%22:true')) {
                html.classList.add('subscriber-user');
            }

            if (document.cookie.includes('lequipe-session-token') || sessionInfos) {
                html.classList.add('may-personalize');
            }

            if (localStorage.getItem('euconsent-v2') !== null || document.cookie.includes('euconsent-v2')) {
                document.querySelector('html').classList.add('consent-defined');
            } else {
                // clean didomi token if no consent
                localStorage.removeItem('didomi_token');
            }

            if (localStorage.getItem('layout:')) {
                let style = localStorage.getItem('layout:');
                style = JSON.parse(style);
                theme = style.colorScheme?.value;
                changeTheme(theme === 'dark');
            }

            function changeTheme(isDark) {
                html.classList.toggle('is-dark', isDark);
                html.classList.toggle('is-light', !isDark);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const themeAttr = isDark ? 'data-dark-theme' : 'data-light-theme';
                    document.querySelectorAll('[' + themeAttr + ']').forEach(el => {
                        el.setAttribute('style', el.getAttribute(themeAttr));
                    });
                }, 1);
            }

            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
                const htmlEl = document.documentElement;
                changeTheme(theme === 'dark');

                const isTouchDevice = ('ontouchstart' in window) ||
                    (navigator.maxTouchPoints && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0) ||
                    (navigator.msMaxTouchPoints && navigator.msMaxTouchPoints > 0);

                if (isTouchDevice) {
                    htmlEl.classList.add('touchevents');
                    htmlEl.classList.remove('no-touchevents');
                } else {
                    htmlEl.classList.add('no-touchevents');
                    htmlEl.classList.remove('touchevents');
                }

                window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
                    const App = htmlEl.querySelector('.App');
                    const scrollDetect = window.scrollY;
                    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--scroll-offset', `${document.documentElement.scrollTop}px`);

                    if (App) {
                        if (scrollY - scrollDetect < 0) {
                            App.classList.remove('is-scrollUp');
                        } else if (scrollY - scrollDetect > 0) {
                            App.classList.add('is-scrollUp');
                        }

                        scrollY = scrollDetect;
                    }
                });
            });
